title: Insiders vouch for Dan Sherman's Above Black

tellings.quote: only read that book specifically because it was told to me by insiders that it was a credible disclosure

plain: Matthew Brown, who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, says he read a book called Above Black by Dan Sherman only because insiders told him it was a credible disclosure. If those insiders are right, the book is a real account from inside secret government work rather than just a story.
